tools.name: start_session
tools.title: Start session
tools.when_to_use: Start a diagramming session and open the live browser preview. Call once before any other draw.io tool in a conversation.

when_not_to_use.case: a session is already active in this conversation

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Get guide sections
tools.when_to_use: Load only the guide sections needed for the current task. Call after start_session and before generating any XML.

when_not_to_use.case: you need the whole guide verbatim in one call

tools.name: get_drawing_guide
tools.title: Get drawing guide (legacy)
tools.when_to_use: Legacy alias. Returns the complete drawing guide in one call, including sections you do not need.

when_not_to_use.case: only part of the guide is needed

tools.name: get_shape_library
tools.title: Get shape library
tools.when_to_use: Get exact style names before drawing vendor icon shapes. Call with no library to list every available library.

when_not_to_use.case: the diagram uses only plain shapes

tools.name: create_new_diagram
tools.title: Create new diagram
tools.when_to_use: Create a brand-new document from XML, REPLACING every page and any unsaved user edits. The previous state stays in History.

when_not_to_use.case: adding another tab to an existing diagram
opening an existing .drawio file from disk

tools.requires: xml; see guide://xml for accepted shapes and rules

tools.name: load_diagram
tools.title: Load .drawio file
tools.when_to_use: Open a .drawio file from disk into the session, REPLACING the whole document. The server reads the file itself; handles plain XML and draw.io compressed format.

when_not_to_use.case: you already have the XML in context and want to redraw
you only want to inspect the in-memory diagram

tools.requires: absolute path; relative paths resolve against the server working directory

tools.name: edit_diagram
tools.title: Edit diagram
tools.when_to_use: Add, update or delete individual cells of an existing page by cell id. Operations are all-or-nothing.

when_not_to_use.case: you only want to read the current state

tools.requires: operations[].cell_id that exist in the current page; unknown ids need get_diagram first

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.title: Get diagram
tools.when_to_use: Read the current diagram XML, including the user's manual browser edits, when you need cell ids, page structure or an exact copy of the state.

when_not_to_use.case: you already know the exact ids you just wrote

tools.name: screenshot_diagram
tools.title: Screenshot diagram
tools.when_to_use: Render the current diagram to a PNG so you can check overlapping shapes and edges crossing shapes after drawing or a heavy edit.
tools.requires: the preview tab to be open

tools.name: export_diagram
tools.title: Export diagram
tools.when_to_use: Save the current diagram to a .drawio, .png, .svg or .drawio.svg file. Format is detected from the file extension.

when_not_to_use.case: only previewing the result on screen

tools.requires: absolute path; optional format and page selector

tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.when_to_use: List every page's id, name, 0-based index and cell count before targeting one with a page selector.

when_not_to_use.case: you need the cells inside a page

tools.name: add_page
tools.title: Add page
tools.when_to_use: Append a new tab WITHOUT touching existing pages or unsaved user edits. Returns the new page id, name and index.
tools.requires: optional name, id and starting xml

tools.name: rename_page
tools.title: Rename page
tools.when_to_use: Change the visible tab label of an existing page.

when_not_to_use.case: changing the cells on a page

tools.requires: one of page_id / page_name / page_index, plus new_name

tools.name: delete_page
tools.title: Delete page
tools.when_to_use: Delete an entire tab. Refuses to delete the last remaining page.
